'''''O.S.S. Telira''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] owned and [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Osman Shrier]], who operated it as a [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]]. It traveled along a ten-day route that included [[Elshandruu Pica]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]] and the [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]] in general. Although the ''O.S.S. Telira''{{'s}} less-than-satisfactory accommodations and service garnered it a three-star rating from critics, its staff were reputed to be friendly and helpful. Additionally, Shrier's charismatic demeanor and clownish appearance won the ''O.S.S. Telira'' a number of return customers.
